ignoreValues.reason: Kleos: detector cannot evaluate clamp() or max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left)), so it reads the band padding and the .shell gutter as 0. Reproduced with minimal cases (clamp vs plain length; env gutter vs literal) - swapping either for a literal clears it. Real insets are 3-7.5rem vertical and >=20px horizontal.
